Keeps the items whose field passes a test and drops the others: a number compared with a value, text that contains a value, or a field being there at all.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `logic.filter` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Field (`field`) | text | yes |  | The item field to test, e.g. spread, or outcomes.0.price for the first outcome's price. |
| Test (`operator`) | text | no | `gt` | One of `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `eq`, `neq`, `contains`, `notContains`, `exists`, `missing`. |
| Value (`value`) | text | no |  | A number for the comparisons, text for contains (any case). Not used by exists and missing. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
